about: Generated by `7wd manifest`; do not edit. C# is the only encoder: Python reads this file to size the network and check shapes. Input values are float32, roughly 0-1, from the point of view of the player to decide ('my' / 'opp'). Unknowns are zeros.

blocks.name: layout
blocks.description: 20 slots of the current Age (slot index as in data/base/layouts.json, empty slots past an Age's last slot stay 0); per slot 0/1 flags empty, back-age (face down, unknown Age card), back-guild (face down, purple Guild back), face-up (known card), accessible, then a one-hot of the face-up card; all 0 before Age I

blocks.name: age
blocks.description: current Age one-hot (all 0 during the Wonder draft)

blocks.name: cards
blocks.description: card-centric 0/1 per location: my city, opponent's city, discard pile, tucked under my / the opponent's Wonders, the Statue of Liberty's undecided returned cards, the card its owner kept (while liberty-give is pending), the card given to the opponent (until it is built)

blocks.name: unseen-cards
blocks.description: 0/1: never named so far and could still be revealed (Age cards of the current or a later Age; Guilds before Age III or while a Guild back is face down)

blocks.name: wonders
blocks.description: 0/1 per Wonder and state; removed = the unbuilt Wonder removed when 7 are built

blocks.name: unseen-wonders
blocks.description: 0/1: in the Wonder pool and not offered yet (could still appear in the draft)

blocks.name: tokens
blocks.description: 0/1 per Progress token: on the board, mine, the opponent's, in my pending Great Library draw

blocks.name: scalars
blocks.description: coins / 20 (capped at 40); my military lead / 9 (-1..1); military tokens still on the board (on my side = the opponent's pawn loots me); cards left in the Age / 20; start-rule-2015 = 1 under start-choice=2015

blocks.name: turn
blocks.description: Pending Decision kind one-hot (front of the queue; all 0 if none), then 0/1: I am the player to decide, it is my turn, a play-again is pending, the destroy target colour, the opponent's Great Library draw is hidden

blocks.name: derived
blocks.description: DerivedFeatures (me, then opponent, then capital distances) divided by: production 4, choice producers 4, trading price 8, science symbols 6, science pairs 6, VP 60, Wonders built 4, open chains 8, capital distance 18

blocks.name: slot-tokens
blocks.description: 0/1 per slot of the current Age (as in layout) and token kind: a Mythology token (Age I) or an Offering token (Age II) still lying on the card in that slot (public, R1/R4)

blocks.name: temple-layout
blocks.description: per slot of the current Age: back-temple (face down, Grand Temple back, R6), then a one-hot of a face-up Grand Temple (layout's flags still say the slot is face up and accessible)

blocks.name: temples
blocks.description: Grand Temple-centric 0/1 per location (as v1's cards block), then unseen (in the game's Temple pool and never named: could still be revealed)

blocks.name: pantheon-wonders
blocks.description: 0/1 per state (as v1's wonders and unseen-wonders blocks) for Pantheon's 2 Wonders

blocks.name: pantheon-tokens
blocks.description: 0/1 per state (as v1's tokens block) for Pantheon's 3 Progress tokens

blocks.name: enki-tokens
blocks.description: 0/1 per Progress token (base and Pantheon): one of the 2 lying on Enki (public, from its Reveal)

blocks.name: pantheon-spaces
blocks.description: per Pantheon space 1..6 (space 1 at P1's capital end): 0/1 empty, gate, face-down, hidden (face down and not known to me: only its Mythology shows), the card's Mythology one-hot, placed by me / by the opponent (a Divinity placed in Age I), then my and the opponent's cost to activate it now / 8 (the Gate doubled, minus 2 with the Sanctuary; 0 on an empty space)

blocks.name: divinities
blocks.description: Divinity-centric 0/1 (the Gate last), only where I know the card: on Pantheon space 1..6, face down there, at deck position 1..3 (top first), in my pending draw, activated by me / the opponent; unseen = not named to me (it may be in a hidden place of its Mythology or unseen in its deck)

blocks.name: decks
blocks.description: per Mythology deck: cards left / 3, then per position 1..3 (top first) 0/1 known to me, known to the opponent (who knows a deck card is public; which card it is shows in divinities only if I know it)

blocks.name: pantheon-held
blocks.description: Mythology tokens held per Mythology / 2 (mine, then the opponent's), Offering tokens held 0/1 (mine, then the opponent's), Astarte's coins / 20 (mine, opponent's)

blocks.name: minerva
blocks.description: 0/1: the Minerva pawn's Military track space, from my point of view (positive = toward the opponent's capital, as v1's military lead; the capitals are -9 and 9)

blocks.name: snake
blocks.description: 0/1: the green card Nisaba's Snake sits on

blocks.name: pantheon-turn
blocks.description: Pantheon Pending Decision kind one-hot (front of the queue; v1's turn block covers the base kinds), then the decision's Mythology (place a drawn Divinity, the Divine Theater's deck) and Divinity (the one an offer pays for, the one theater-order activates), and draw-hidden: the opponent's pending draw is hidden

policy.masking: illegal Moves are set to -inf before the softmax; the legal mask comes from C#

blocks.name: destroy
blocks.description: destroy <card>, brown and grey cards only

blocks.name: wonder-pantheon
blocks.description: wonder <card> <wonder> for the pairs v1 lacks: base card x Pantheon Wonder (index = card * 2 + wonder - 14), then Grand Temple x every Wonder

blocks.name: offer
blocks.description: offer <Offering tokens>: index = the tokens as a mask (offer none = 0)

blocks.name: zeus
blocks.description: zeus <slot> of an Age: index = (age - 1) * 20 + slot (named 'zeus age<N> <row.col>')

blocks.name: isis
blocks.description: isis <card> <wonder>: index = card * 16 + wonder (Grand Temples included)

blocks.name: minerva
blocks.description: minerva <space> (-9..9, positive toward P2's capital, as the Move Log writes it)

policy.target: Gumbel's improved policy (root visit shares in classic mode), over legal Moves

value.target: final result for the player to decide: +1 win, 0 draw, -1 loss

outcome.target: the actual result's class, from the point of view of the player to decide
